title: Digital Divide
author: oA7a2DXCeN3DLamvj
chapter_outcomes: What the digital divide is, including: the gap between people and regions that have access to aspects of modern technology and information, and those with restricted or no access. The technology includes telephone, television, personal computers and the internet. The digital divide can also exist because of availability of high and low performance computers, wireless connections

Causes and effects of the digital divide, including: groups affected include: people in cities and people in rural areas, the educated and uneducated, the old and young, socioeconomic groups, more and less industrially developed/technologically aware nations. Effects of the digital divide include inequality of access to all types of internet services
Reducing the effects of the digital divide
